The ticket also requires that a pause and an admission hold can be live at the same time and are released independently. The plan contract (19.P3.admission-holds-activation) does not say which identity goes in the single `hold_id` slot when both are live, or how the slot is derived from the queue's hold. Without that, publishing the admission identity needs either an edit to control.py, which is outside the fence, or a precedence rule invented by daemon.py.
